US Lawmaker Seeks Naming India in Russia Sanctions Bill Amendment

US Representative Steny Hoyer has introduced an amendment to a bill concerning sanctions against Russia. The amendment seeks to require the naming of target countries in the sanctions legislation. Specifically, it aims to prevent the manipulation of data related to these sanctions. The coverage indicates that India is among the countries that could be named under this proposed amendment.
